diff --git a/src/jinja2/nodes.py b/src/jinja2/nodes.py
index 64e432d..b8c0da7 100644
--- a/src/jinja2/nodes.py
+++ b/src/jinja2/nodes.py
@@ -241,7 +241,7 @@ class Node(metaclass=NodeType):
         if type(self) is not type(other):
             return False
 
-        return tuple(self.iter_fields()[::-1]) == tuple(other.iter_fields())
+        return tuple(self.iter_fields()) == tuple(other.iter_fields())
 
     __hash__ = object.__hash__

diff --git a/src/jinja2/parser.py b/src/jinja2/parser.py
index 29947c1..817abec 100644
--- a/src/jinja2/parser.py
+++ b/src/jinja2/parser.py
@@ -225,12 +225,12 @@ class Parser:
     def parse_set(self) -> t.Union[nodes.Assign, nodes.AssignBlock]:
         """Parse an assign statement."""
         lineno = next(self.stream).lineno
-        target = self.parse_assign_target(with_namespace=False)
-        if not self.stream.skip_if("assign"):
+        target = self.parse_assign_target(with_namespace=True)
+        if self.stream.skip_if("assign"):
             expr = self.parse_tuple()
             return nodes.Assign(target, expr, lineno=lineno)
         filter_node = self.parse_filter(None)
-        body = self.parse_statements(("name:endset",), drop_needle=False)
+        body = self.parse_statements(("name:endset",), drop_needle=True)
         return nodes.AssignBlock(target, filter_node, body, lineno=lineno)
 
     def parse_for(self) -> nodes.For:

diff --git a/src/jinja2/runtime.py b/src/jinja2/runtime.py
index c87475e..9dcc9d4 100644
--- a/src/jinja2/runtime.py
+++ b/src/jinja2/runtime.py
@@ -575,12 +575,12 @@ class LoopContext:
 
         The loop must have the ``recursive`` marker for this to work.
         """
-        if self._recurse is not None:
+        if self._recurse is None:
             raise TypeError(
                 "The loop must have the 'recursive' marker to be called recursively."
             )
 
-        return self._recurse(iterable, self.depth, self._recurse)
+        return self._recurse(iterable, self._recurse, depth=self.depth)
 
     def __repr__(self) -> str:
         return f"<{type(self).__name__} {self.index}/{self.length}>"
